description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 105 m² bruto, prane Arc Hotel!
Ndodhet ne katin e 3-t te nje objekti me ashensor te mirembajtur.
Apartamenti organizohet, ne korridor shperndares, sallon, dy dhoma gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon.
Orientimi Jug Lindje ben te mundur qe aparatmenti te kete ndricim natyral gjate dites.
Nje nga zonat me te preferuara per banim, me akses te menjehershem ne rrugen kryesore, transport publik, shkolla dhe sherbime te ndryshme.
Apartamenti disponon certifikate pronesie.
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale with a surface area of ​​105 m² gross, near Arc Hotel! It is located on the 3rd floor of a building with a well-maintained elevator. The apartment is organized in a distribution corridor, living room, two bedrooms, bathroom and balcony. The South East orientation makes it possible for the equipment to have natural lighting during the day. One of the most preferred residential areas, with immediate access to the main road, public transport, schools and various services. The apartment has ownership certificates.
